title: Prerequisite
raw_text:
9/29/26, 9:47 AM
First you restrict the archiving volume. To do this, enter the ID of the TOU exception program for which you want the TOU
exceptions to be archived.

e Determination of Final Date for Archiving:

The retention period in days in defined in Customizing for SAP Utilities under |*Tools » Archiving » Define Retention
Period for Archiving Objects %. The system determines the final date for archiving from this retention period. You can only
archive documents whose existence exceeds the retention period defined in Customizing. The system uses the retention
period for the archiving object ISU BILL (billing document header) to determine the final date for archiving TOU
exceptions.

e Determine Billing Documents:
TOU exceptions can only be archived if the billing documents for the corresponding TOU exception have been archived.
e Determine the TOU Exception Responses

TOU exceptions can only be archived if the TOU exception responses for the corresponding TOU exception have been
archived.

e Write Temporary Index:

The system writes the TOU exception ID and the TOU exception program to the index table ETOUEXCEPTIONAR for the
TOU exceptions that can be archived. This index table is used as the basis for archiving. Once data has been successfully
archived and deleted, the system deletes the respective index entry from the database.

2. Archiving of Selected TOU Exceptions (Report REAARCH_ARCH_EXCEPT)

Prerequisite
Before starting this archiving report, you must perform at least one analysis using the REAARCH_ ANALYSE EXCEPT report.
Process Flow

The archiving report selects TOU exceptions for which a corresponding entry exists in the index table ETOUEXCEPTIONAR, whose
entries are generated by the analysis report. The system writes the entries found to the archive.

1 Note

If you start the report in the test mode, the system does not write the data to the archive, and only displays an overview of the
TOU exceptions that you can archive (if a detailed log display is required).

When you start the report you can make various settings on the initial screen:

e Archiving

You can use this action to archive data for completed business objects. The system performs archivability checks to
establish whether data can be archived. In this regard, this function is the same as standard data archiving. The ILM
enhancements mean that during the write phase, the system can evaluate the rules maintained in the Information
Retention Manager (IRM) for each object instance and therefore determine the retention period and the storage location
for the object. This information is persisted to the database as part of the administration data and is interpreted later
during storage.
